notes.title: MoB v1.0.2 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[i]- Fixed not being able to see the unlockables if you leveled up more than once at the same time.
- Fixed trade goods not being visilble on cart.
- Fixed jittery camera at Skalitz.
- Fixed missing textures at winter.
- Fixed not being able to hide the path at winter.

+ Improved trade good models[/i]

Please report the bugs you encounter at www.snougames.com

notes.title: MoB v1.0.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[b]Thank you all for your interest in game.

We needed to release a quick update to fix several issues.[/b]

[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
[i]- Fixed a bug about not correctly calculating the recruit quantity.
- Fixed a bug about freezing unlocked location cameras.
- Fixed a bug about giving 0 groschens to beggar.
- Fixed a bug where it didn't let you travel to Ledethcko even if it's unlocked.

+ Now you can rotate trade goods or units while inspecting.[/i]

We may have to release updates in upcoming days if new bugs are found, please report the bugs you encounter at www.snougames.com

notes.title: Merchant of Bohemia Is Released!
notes.notes:
After 9+ months of development, MoB is finally ready to play. This doesn't mean it's in its ideal form yet, but we'll keep improving the game for a few more months.

Development of MoB made us learn so much and we can't wait to develop better games in the future by using what we learned.

What you can expect in future updates:

- Hard Mode & Online Leaderboard
- Localization for French and Turkish
- Achievements
- Optimization, Polishes & Bug Fixes
- Game Balance Fixes

Please visit our website to share your opinions, ideas or bugs you found: www.snougames.com
